Hi there, I'm Dr. Darcy Fass, founder & creator of Tips and Pediatricks, LLC. I'm a pediatric physical therapist and mother of a sweet & sassy little girl living/working in the Sunshine State! I love posting tips & tricks on how to support your child's motor development, giving you a glimpse into my life as a working mom, AND sharing my honest reviews on some of the best baby, toddler, and kid products on the market!

For collabs/partnership opportunities: Email me at tips.and.pediatricks@gmail.com
Join my community on Instagram: @tips_and_pediatricks

Content by Tips and Pediatricks - Dr. Darcy is for educational purposes only and is never a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult with your child's healthcare team. Use this information at your own risk. By viewing this content, you agree to this disclaimer.
